freeze_rule: Owner must explicitly approve implementation, consumers, quarantine mapping and thresholds binding this protocol SHA-256 before any experiment execution, normalization or exclusion-result access. Later changes require a new version and approval; never tune against viewed results.

consumers.scope: Sanitized per-date and pooled field-presence/count audit only; no application UI, strategy or production consumer.
Uniqueness and explicit missing contract-date count checks only; no continuous series, prices aggregated into returns, cross-date filling or research.

quarantine.row_mapping: Map each row-level blocking range diagnostic to its uniquely joined exact contract and trading date, retaining original diagnostic codes, source row locator and package provenance in ignored local outputs. Duplicate/conflicting identities stop evaluation.
quarantine.date_rule: Row-filtered view is an audit artifact, not a safe subset. The entire date with unknown attribution remains restricted for OHLC comparisons and prohibited production/research use. Report restricted-date row count separately, never silently drop the date or clear diagnostic.
quarantine.storage: If separately approved, create a new ignored SQLite experimental database in the existing isolated root; never open the existing local F&O database. Original facts append-once, view masks only; no destructive update, repair, archive extraction or original-path restoration.

metrics.denominators: Report per date, pooled, and instrument class per date. Compute from baseline before exclusion; zero denominator is NOT_EVALUATED, never zero.
metrics.comparison: Any positive value is MATERIAL_FOR_COVERAGE; zero does not establish semantic validity.

metrics.denominators: Per field, date and instrument class. Unavailable includes quarantine gaps; zero and not-applicable are distinguished from missing.

metrics.formula: Number of baseline exact contract-date keys unavailable in filtered view
metrics.denominators: Per date, pooled and instrument class; never global row percentage alone.

metrics.formula: Number of approved offline consumer invariants failing beyond the explicitly expected mask/coverage differences
metrics.denominators: List each planned test and baseline/experimental PASS, FAIL or NOT_EVALUATED; no percent of passing tests.

metrics.formula: Number of baseline rows on dates with unresolved date-level attribution
metrics.denominators: Per restricted date and pooled; separate from quarantined row count.

missing_data: No forward-fill, interpolation, clamping, settlement substitution, continuous-contract fallback, alternate-price substitution or implicit date removal. Unknown remains unknown; exact Decimal source facts remain byte/digest bound.
integrity_plan: Verify root containment, no reparse/symlink ancestors or files, exact date directories and expected two payloads plus new manifest; fail before row access on any mismatch.
Bind each new manifest hash in the fresh reconciliation, verify its selected date, roles, exact URLs, filenames, sizes, SHA-256 and no extra payloads against the reacquisition receipt.
Verify receipt and sealed historical manifest hashes; new timestamps imply new manifests and never replace historical bindings.
Use bounded ZIP/GZIP integrity validation without extraction before normalization; verify embedded TradDt for all UDiFF rows.
Invoke unchanged R10N-H candidate normalization for all dates offline, retain exact price-tuple digests, unique joins and decoded expiry agreement; compare aggregate diagnostics with sealed R10N-I.
Any mismatch, corrupt archive, changed schema, unexpected diagnostic or diagnostic-count disagreement stops before filtering.

corroboration.evidence_selection: Only specifically recorded, already available alternative evidence with owner permission and publisher provenance; do not scan Dashboard databases, raw archives or unrelated folders to invent authorization.
corroboration.rule: Every key and semantics must agree exactly; unknown, missing, duplicate, adjusted prices, continuous series or ambiguous session fails closed. Symbol similarity is insufficient. Equal vendor values do not establish NSE field rules.
corroboration.independence: Record direct collection versus redistribution; unknown lineage is NOT_ESTABLISHED, never independent corroboration.
corroboration.gated_next_scope: Prepare an exact evidence request only after contract identities are available in approved ignored outputs. Bind provider, endpoint/query or local file hashes, exact two contract-date keys, requested fields, transaction/payload limits and retention permission; owner must separately approve before acquisition. No Kite credentials, yfinance calls, website scraping, contact messages or additional downloads now.

required_future_tests: Integrity failure prevents normalization and exclusion
Date diagnostic persists after row exclusion
Nonblocking zero-volume and settlement diagnostics remain visible
All matching keys and semantics fail closed on missing/mismatch
No network, substitution, fingerprint refresh or source activation
Experimental results never mutate historical acceptance
permitted_conclusions: Only bounded coverage/completeness effects for named offline consumers. No strategy-wide sensitivity from three sparse dates, no source qualification, no evidence deletion, no price correctness proof, and no acceptance-policy amendment. Nonmaterial findings require a separate owner policy decision; they do not auto-approve exclusion.
